name: Chem-synth
text: If Standing at the start of an activation, the wearer may pass a free Intelligence test to reduce targets' Toughness by one against Gas and Toxin attacks made that activation.

name: Phelynx
text: An exotic beast pet (profile in 13-gangs 3.6). Exotic beasts are outside the v1 scope, so the engine ignores this purchase; it is kept so the Wyld Skirmishers starter gang keeps its printed cost.
